event_text: The Discord server of a leading fan PC-port project vanishes; its GitHub page also goes offline that evening
notes: Time from Tarreo (about 23:06 GMT). Creator says Rockstar took the server down; not confirmed.

event_text: Take-Two files court requests for DMCA subpoenas to Microsoft and Discord over GTA 6 leaks
notes: Per the court filings; concerns the August leaks.

event_text: The court orders the clerk to issue Take-Two's DMCA subpoenas to Microsoft and Discord
notes: Per the signed orders on the docket.

event_text: Rockstar publishes a letter calling the leaked gameplay videos 'heartbreaking for our team'
notes: Per the letter as printed by outlets.

event_text: The court orders another DMCA subpoena to Discord issued
notes: Per the signed order on the docket.

event_text: GTA 6 goes on sale; the leaker announces it is sharing a near-complete Xbox build, about 209 GB, minus the executable
notes: Per the leaker's own post as reported; GameGPU, Kotaku and PC Gamer date it Nov 19.

event_text: Outlets report the leaker posted the executable ahead of its countdown
notes: GameGPU, Wccftech and DSOGaming, relaying the leaker; time of day not stated.

event_text: TechRadar reports the executable is due to be released that day
notes: Publication time of the TechRadar article.
